audit.note: the 24 Avatars toast client-side via control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show with '{0} Pressed' filled by $event.oSource.sId (roundtrip-free) - the app has no on_event

deviations.what: the sap.m.Avatar control (since UI5 1.73) is newer than 1.71 and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1, the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.73.

the Avatar properties badgeIcon (since UI5 1.77), badgeIconColor (since UI5 1.132, its enum sap.m.AvatarBadgeColor too, with the values Indication1..Indication10 only since UI5 1.140) and badgeValueState (since UI5 1.116) are what this sample demonstrates and are kept 1:1 on all 24 Avatars - the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.140 to render every badge colour.

onPress toasts oEvent.getSource().getId() + ' Pressed'. All 24 press wires reproduce that client-side and roundtrip-free (follow_up_action control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show, template '{0} Pressed' filled by $event.oSource.sId, app 127 precedent); the id itself is a UI5 runtime value whose view prefix differs from the original's.
